Charcoal, smoky indigo, rust-red crayon accents, muted sage, pale ochre and warm cream. Rich visible handmade grain, delicate linework, organic irregular edges and areas of unmarked paper. Keep the composition legible at website sizes, no central robot, no humanoid AI, no glowing brain, no interface, no text, no lettering, no religious icon used as triumphal emblem, no logos or watermark. Image only, not a website mockup.
